evidence.V4: Consistent rounded chamfers on board frame, raised face panel, chevron and caps; the board_edge and icon close-ups show bevels catching a clean highlight line.

evidence.V6: Hues disciplined (wood brown in 3 values, gold accent, ink bolts), but value contrast on the focal icon is weak: in the flat close-up the gold chevron is nearly the same value as the light tan face panel and almost disappears.
evidence.V7: 788 tris vs medium target 2000 (ceiling 4000): well under target with no wasted density.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold accent, ink bolts, single wood hue in three values, chamfers in kit scale and smooth shading; colourways (walnut, teal, crimson, royal) swap the hue cleanly and keep the gold and ink.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (A12 pass).
